newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: NZ budget to conform to coalition deal - Birch.
newsitem.headline: NZ budget to conform to coalition deal - Birch.

text.p: New Zealand Finance Minister Bill Birch said on Wednesday he sees Budget forecasts being in line with projections made in the December coalition agreement between National and New Zealand First.
"I expect the Budget forecasts to be very consistent with the predictions made in the coalition agreement," he told a Deloittes seminar in Wellington.
The coalition agreement outlined a set of fiscal parameters within which the total spending of the coalition government over its three year term would be contained.
Those parameters showed the government surplus at NZ$3.03 billion in 1997/98, or three percent of Gross Domestic Product (GDP).
